q: for this religious choice (our holy creed, for which our last lost battle has been fought), O Mazda! Thy blessed Order (our guardian help) has yet been set to save and bless us.

s: Good Mind is a sheltering leadership (within the folk and commanders)
q: Therefore do I pray (the more) for the sheltering leadership of Thy Good Mind (within our folk and our commanders).

s: Good Mind gives power to the believing natures (as a source of strength)
q: who (will yet dare these unbelieving foes) and guard the Faith (against that envious Wrath), and with the Good Mind's power.

s: Bendva fights with the speaker (ever since he first appeared)
q: Bendva has ever fought with me; (yea, since he first appeared at hand to threaten, and alas to his advantage in the strife)

s: Bountiful Âramaiti is a bountiful and perfect virtue
q: The bountiful and perfect Piety he has not maintained nor strengthened for this land

s: Mazdayasnian Faith is a religious choice (the holy creed)
q: for this religious choice (our holy creed, for which our last lost battle has been fought)

s: Wrath-demon of rapine is associated with Râma (with her)
q: They who with evil scheme and will shall cherish and help on the Wrath of Rapine, and with her Râma

s: Râma is associated with Wrath-demon of rapine (as her companion)
q: They who with evil scheme and will shall cherish and help on the Wrath of Rapine, and with her Râma

s: Daêvas are supported by the allies of the wicked (through evil schemes and words)
q: These settle and support the Daêvas (in their power, not the Lord).

s: Daêvas are supported by the wicked (in their power, not the Lord)
q: These settle and support the Daêvas (in their power, not the Lord).

s: the Lie has Demon-of-the-Lie (as an evil judge)
q: But) for (that evil) Judge, the Demon-of-the-Lie, (is set) to deal (for him) her wounds.

s: the Lie has abode (where evil souls dwell)
q: and in the Lie's abode their dwelling verily shall be!

s: Bendva's death is sought by Ahura Mazda (through Good Mind)
q: Through (Thine inspiring) Good Mind obtain (for me) that (Bendva's) death!

s: Bendva is a powerful adversary (in brutal might)
q: He is the most powerful (in brutal might)

s: Bendva's death is a desired outcome (requested as relief from sorrow)
q: Come then with gifts of (vengeful) good to (meet) my sorrow. Through (Thine inspiring) Good Mind obtain (for me) that (Bendva's) death!

s: the wicked cherish Wrath-demon of rapine (with evil scheme and will)
q: They who with evil scheme and will shall cherish and help on the Wrath of Rapine

s: the wicked support Daêvas (in their power, not the Lord)
q: These settle and support the Daêvas (in their power, not the Lord).

s: the wicked is perverted Mazdayasnian Faith (the wicked's)
q: It is the wicked's Faith and Insight (so to do. Their faith is the perverted).

s: Bendva has evil judge
q: for that Bendva's evil judge doth cause me to hesitate and ponder (in my earnest course of propagation and reform)

s: the souls of the evil dead dwell in the Lie (in the Lie's abode)
q: and in the Lie's abode their dwelling verily shall be!

s: the zealous and thrifty husbandman is a helper and blesser (formed for giving help and blessings)
q: let the zealous and thrifty husbandman, so formed for giving help and blessings, give heed and listen when I call

s: the truthful tiller is distinguished from the wicked (must not take the sheltering chieftainship together with them)
q: Let not the truthful (tiller, he who hears and speaks Thy word), be he who takes that sheltering chieftainship together with the wicked.

s: Bendva is a deceiver
q: a deceiver as he is, (estranged) from the Righteous Order

s: Bendva is estranged from Righteous Order (from the Righteous Order)
q: a deceiver as he is, (estranged) from the Righteous Order

s: Bendva maintains Bountiful Âramaiti (not; for this land)
q: The bountiful and perfect Piety he has not maintained nor strengthened for this land

s: Bendva asks questions of Good Mind (not)
q: nor questions with Thy Good Mind hath he asked (to gain him light), O Lord!

s: Ahura Mazda is a Lord
q: O Lord!

s: Ahura Mazda is a Great Creator
q: What aids of grace hast Thou for Thine invoking Zarathustra, (O Ahura Mazda!) to grant him through Thy Righteous Order?

s: Zarathustra gives understanding (for this land)
q: giver of understanding for this land

s: Zarathustra guides voice (toward glory)
q: voice-guider (of the way to glory)

s: Zarathustra proclaims regulations (in accordance with Good Mind)
q: let him indeed proclaim and teach my regulations, and in accordance with Thy Good Mind (as his law).

s: the speaker (the supplicant) is a supplicant (who gains his ends)
q: may I (like him) become a supplicant who gains his ends.

s: the speaker (the supplicant) prays to Ahura Mazda (with praises)
q: for me who will (still) pray to Thee with praises, O Great Creator!

s: the speaker (the supplicant) seeks land (living in justice)
q: Do Thou then grant me lands (so would I ask of Thee) which live in justice in the many splendours of the sun

s: the speaker (the supplicant) offers worship (with praises)
q: will I give sacrifice to You with praises, O Ahura Mazda!

s: the speaker (the supplicant) approaches Ahura Mazda (with Yasnas, prayer, and worship)
q: Yea, with these Yasnas of Your sacrifice would I approach You

s: the speaker (the supplicant) has power over sacred privilege (at his will)
q: so long indeed as I shall have the power, commanding at my will o’er this my sacred (privilege) and gift.

s: Righteous Order is a way of righteousness (the only way to obtain the Kine's welfare)
q: (That only way is righteousness.)

s: Ahura Mazda is a Lord
q: Aye, doth my soul indeed obtain assisting grace, and which of Thy blessings is that gift to me, O Lord?

s: Righteous Order saves flocks and herds (as a saving champion)
q: What saving champion is found to save both flocks and herds? And who for myself other than Thy Righteous Order

s: Righteous Order enables Kine (to be possessed)
q: let that joy-creating one) be his possession through the Righteous Order

s: Good Mind is a law (for Zarathustra)
q: and in accordance with Thy Good Mind (as his law).

s: Good Mind gives grace (within the speaker's soul)
q: what (aids of grace hast thou for me as) through Thy Good Mind given (within my soul)

s: Good Mind is a virtue (in the speaker's soul)
q: and with the good virtue of (Your) Good Mind (in my soul).

s: Divine Sovereign Power is a sacred power (of Ahura Mazda)
q: and in accordance with Thy sacred Sovereign Power

s: Kine is a living symbol of peace (joy-creating)
q: that joy-creating Kine (who is the living symbol of our peace)

s: Kine has pastures (for the welfare of the land)
q: who shall desire to see her provided with pastures for (the welfare of) this land?

s: land live in justice (in the many splendours of the sun)
q: grant me lands (so would I ask of Thee) which live in justice in the many splendours of the sun

s: land are sought and gained by the speaker (the supplicant) (as conquests for the cause)
q: and lands which openly thus live, and which are to be sought and gained by me (as conquests for the cause).

s: Ahura Mazda is a Great Giver
q: are all, through their Righteous Order, (the speakers) of Thy praise, O Thou Great Giver, Lord!

s: Home-of-song contains the speaker (the supplicant) (after death)
q: and in Thine Home-of-song shall I (by means of these my Yasnas offered here) there hear the praises of Thine offering saints who see Thy face.

s: Mãthra-word is spoken by the speaker of Your Mãthra-word (with open acts of visible relief)
q: since Ye advance with friendliness to cheer the speaker of Your Mãthra-word with open acts of visible relief

s: worship is offered to Ahura Mazda (with praises)
q: will I give sacrifice to You with praises, O Ahura Mazda!

s: Yasna are offered to Ahura Mazda (as sacrifice)
q: Yea, with these Yasnas of Your sacrifice would I approach You

s: praises are heard in Home-of-song (as offered by saints)
q: and in Thine Home-of-song shall I (by means of these my Yasnas offered here) there hear the praises of Thine offering saints who see Thy face.

s: Prayer is offered to Ahura Mazda (with praises)
q: for me who will (still) pray to Thee with praises, O Great Creator!

s: the stars praise Ahura Mazda (through Righteous Order)
q: these as) the stars, suns, and the Aurora which brings on the light of days, are all, through their Righteous Order, (the speakers) of Thy praise, O Thou Great Giver, Lord!

s: the sun praises Ahura Mazda (through Righteous Order)
q: these as) the stars, suns, and the Aurora which brings on the light of days, are all, through their Righteous Order, (the speakers) of Thy praise, O Thou Great Giver, Lord!

s: the Aurora praises Ahura Mazda (through Righteous Order)
q: these as) the stars, suns, and the Aurora which brings on the light of days, are all, through their Righteous Order, (the speakers) of Thy praise, O Thou Great Giver, Lord!

s: world gives help my fellow-servants (through Good Mind)
q: And may the maker of the world give help through (His implanted) Good Mind (in my fellow-servants).

s: Ahura Mazda has Divine Sovereign Power (sacred)
q: and in accordance with Thy sacred Sovereign Power

s: Ahura Mazda advances with friendliness (to cheer the Mãthra-word speaker)
q: since Ye advance with friendliness to cheer the speaker of Your Mãthra-word with open acts of visible relief

s: Ahura Mazda is praised by the speaker (the supplicant) (through Yasnas and holy works)
q: Yea, with these Yasnas of Your sacrifice would I approach You, praising back to You (in answer to Your mercies), O Ahura!

s: Zarathustra is a faithful friend (in accordance with the Holy Order)
q: he, Zarathustra, the faithful friend in accordance with the Holy Order

s: Zarathustra is a Mãthra-speaker (already lifting his voice in Mãthras)
q: he who already lifts his voice in Mãthras, O Ahura Mazda! he, Zarathustra

s: Good Government (of Ahura) is a lot (chosen among wished-for things)
q: The good Government (of Ahura) is to be chosen (among all wished-for things) as that lot which most of all brings on (our happiness).

s: Ahura Mazda knows the man whose best gift for the sacrifice is given unto me (through the motive of Righteousness)
q: For Ahura Mazda knoweth the man whose best gift for the sacrifice is given unto me, and from the motive of Righteousness

s: Zarathustra is a Spitâma
q: Who, O Ahura! is a loyal friend to the Spitâma, to Zarathustra?

s: Zarathustra is worthy the cause of Righteousness (from earliest days)
q: ('Who is worthy?' would I ask, for Zarathustra was ever such, and from earliest days. He was no polluted wretch.)

s: Zarathustra is not followed by the Paederasts (when his body was maturely grown)
q: Paederast never gained his ear, nor Kavi-follower on this (temptation-)bridge of earth, when his body was (maturely) grown

s: Kavi Vîstâspa attains wisdom (in the Realm of the great cause)
q: Kavi Vîstâspa has reached it in the Realm of our great cause (of devotion)

s: Kavi Vîstâspa gives Sovereign Power (to Maidhyô-mâh the Spitâma)
q: This established Sovereign Power the heroic (Kavi Vîstâspa has given), O Maidhyô-mâh the Spitâma.

s: Kavi Vîstâspa is a man of Âramaiti (bounteous and understanding in words and actions)
q: Yea, this Kavi Vîstâspa) the man of Âramaiti is bounteous, and with understanding in his words and his actions.

s: Good Mind inspires our worship (within the soul)
q: those spiritual blessings which are advantageous for our worship (of Ahura) through (the inspiration of His) Good Mind (within the soul).

s: Good Mind speaks Mãthra (within it)
q: those (inspired) words (which proceed) from the tongue of Thy Good Mind (as he speaks within Thy Mãthra).

s: Good Government (of Ahura) brings on happiness (most of all among wished-for things)
q: The good Government (of Ahura) is to be chosen (among all wished-for things) as that lot which most of all brings on (our happiness).
